help.title: Ways to pay
paragraphs: Log in to make a free one-time payment or enroll in Autopay. Payments processed by 11:59 p.m. ET on a business day post that day; payments made on weekends or holidays post the next business day.
The automated phone line at 1-800-449-8767 is free and open 24/7. Paying with an agent is optional and may carry a fee that you are told before you pay.

By mail, send a check or money order payable to Onity Mortgage with your coupon to P.O. Box 660093, Dallas, TX 75266-0093, 5 to 7 business days before the due date. You can also pay through MoneyGram (receive code 7440) or Western Union (city code ONITY, state NJ).

help.title: Autopay programs
paragraphs: Autopay is free and drafts a checking or savings account. Choose Once-a-Month, Biweekly (half your payment every two weeks) or Twice-a-Month (two dates you pick), and add extra principal if you like. Enroll online after you log in, or send the Autopay form.

Enrollment requests are processed within five business days. If the first draft would fall within 10 days of your due date, drafting starts the following month, so keep paying another way until your confirmation letter arrives.

help.title: Change or cancel Autopay
paragraphs: To cancel Once-a-Month or Biweekly Autopay, log in, go to the Payment section and select the Autopay link. Twice-a-Month Autopay is changed or cancelled through Customer Care at 1-800-449-8767 (or in writing), at least three business days before the draft date.
Bank account changes must reach us at least three business days before your next draft. Wait one business day after an online cancellation before enrolling again.

help.title: Due dates and late charges
paragraphs: Payments are generally due on the 1st. Your monthly statement shows any grace period before a late charge. A payment not received by the last business day of the month may be reported to the credit bureaus.
If your loan just transferred to Onity, payments sent to your prior servicer during the first 60 days are not charged a late fee or reported as late.

help.title: Mortgage assistance
paragraphs: If you are having trouble making payments, call Customer Care at 1-800-449-8767 (Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. ET, Saturday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET). Options can include a repayment plan, forbearance, a loan modification, a partial claim, a short sale or a deed in lieu of foreclosure.
